evals.name: ts-wellkept-readonly-zh
evals.prompt: 这个仓库的注释太多了，有些已经过时，会误导 agent。先帮我看看都有哪些注释、删掉能省多少行，先别改代码。
evals.expected_output: Read-only report on a well-kept TypeScript repo: cloc-based counts excluding vendor/ and .gen., classified five-class table catching the contradictory stale retry comment while keeping JSDoc codegen tags, empty-catch comment, section header and decision records, realistic sample-based delete estimate (~4 lines, not raw countedLines), proposed ADR and issue, and zero file edits.

assertions.name: measured-count
assertions.text: The report gives comment line counts produced by comment_ratchet.py report or cloc, not a guessed number.

assertions.name: five-classes
assertions.text: Comments are classified into tautology, stale, excuse, decision record and directive, with quoted file:line examples.

assertions.name: no-edits
assertions.text: No file in the target repository is modified or created (git status is clean).

assertions.name: excludes-generated-and-vendor
assertions.text: Excludes vendor/ and .gen. generated files from the measured counts and lists excluded/not-covered paths.

assertions.name: catches-stale-contradiction
assertions.text: Classifies the contradictory retry comment in src/retry.ts (claims 5 linear 1000ms retries while code uses 3 exponential 250ms retries) as Stale.

assertions.name: protects-keep-it-traps
assertions.text: Preserves (does not mark for deletion) the exported JSDoc @description blocks in src/types.ts, the empty-catch comment in src/retry.ts, and the section header with spec pointer in src/retry.ts.

assertions.name: realistic-delete-estimate
assertions.text: Gives a sample-based deletable line estimate in the realistic range (2-7 lines, not raw countedLines=21) with sample size, and notes that trailing comments are not counted by cloc.

evals.name: ts-wellkept-apply-ratchet-en
evals.prompt: Clean up the comments under src/ and add a lint so comment count can only go down. Don't post anything to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Scoped src/ cleanup on well-kept TypeScript repo: deletes tautology and contradictory stale comments, preserves JSDoc codegen tags, empty-catch comment, section header, directives, and decision records (marked WHY: or moved to ADR-0002 following docs/adr/), records excuses in docs/comment-debt.md, copies comment_ratchet.py, creates src/-scoped baseline excluding .gen., wires check into existing package.json/CI gate, runs npm test, reports before/after counts, and demonstrates check failing on a throwaway comment and passing cleanly after revert.

assertions.name: local-issues
assertions.text: Excuse comments are recorded in docs/comment-debt.md (with file, line, issue, and removal condition), not posted to an external tracker.

assertions.name: ratchet-wired
assertions.text: Ratchet script is copied into the repo, a src/-scoped baseline excluding generated files exists, and check is wired into an existing gate (package.json or CI, ensuring cloc is available in CI) without adding a new hook framework.

assertions.name: ratchet-proven
assertions.text: The check is demonstrated failing on a throwaway added comment and passing with exit code 0 after reverting the throwaway, leaving no leftover throwaway comment.

assertions.name: directives-kept
assertions.text: Tool directives (eslint-disable and @ts-expect-error) are untouched.

assertions.name: removes-noise-and-stale
assertions.text: Deletes tautology comments (src/types.ts, src/cache.ts) and the contradictory stale comment (src/retry.ts), while leaving vendor/ and src/api.gen.ts untouched.

assertions.name: no-over-deletion-and-tests-pass
assertions.text: Preserves JSDoc @description blocks in src/types.ts, empty-catch comment and section header in src/retry.ts, and decision records; npm test passes after edits.

assertions.name: before-after-and-adr
assertions.text: Reports before/after counted comment lines and handles the long cross-file cache/retry decision record via existing docs/adr/ convention (ADR-0002) or explicit WHY:/ADR marker without inventing a conflicting ADR layout.

evals.name: py-noisy-apply-precommit-zh
evals.prompt: 把 src/ 下面的废话注释和过时注释清掉，顺便加上防止注释继续变多的检查。不要发到外部 issue 平台，也别影响现有测试。
evals.expected_output: Scoped src/ cleanup on Python repo: deletes tautologies and both stale comments, keeps runtime-used module docstring, empty-except comment, section header, directives (SPDX, noqa, type: ignore), and decision records, records excuses in docs/comment-debt.md, excludes generated_pb2.py, wires ratchet check into existing .pre-commit-config.yaml, proves fail-then-pass ratchet check, reports before/after counts, and keeps python3 -m unittest passing.

assertions.name: removes-python-noise-and-stale
assertions.text: Deletes the tautology comments and both stale comments (contradictory dedupe_latest comment and obsolete XML/DATA-104 comment) in src/ingest.py and src/transform.py, leaving src/generated_pb2.py untouched.

assertions.name: preserves-docstring-and-traps
assertions.text: Preserves the runtime-used module docstring in src/ingest.py, the section header and empty-except comment in src/transform.py, decision records, and all directives (SPDX, noqa, type: ignore); python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes.

assertions.name: local-debt-recorded
assertions.text: Records the two excuse comments (FIXME and TODO) in docs/comment-debt.md with file, line, problem, and removal condition, without external posting.

assertions.name: wires-existing-precommit
assertions.text: Copies the ratchet script into the repo, generates a src/-scoped baseline excluding generated_pb2.py, wires check into existing .pre-commit-config.yaml without adding a new hook framework, and proves fail-then-pass with exit code 0 on final tree.

evals.name: mixed-monorepo-implicit-audit-en
evals.prompt: Audit the comments across this repo. We have both TypeScript and Python code and I want to know what's noise, what's stale, what should become an ADR, and where a comment ratchet would fit.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit report across TypeScript and Python without editing any files: measured counts with allowedLines > 0 and vendor/ excluded, five-class table catching both contradictory stale comments while protecting JSDoc/section-header/catch traps, cross-file ADR proposal for monotonic clientSeq, realistic sample-based estimate (~10 lines), existing CI/package.json gate recommendation, and Not covered list.

assertions.name: stops-read-only
assertions.text: Stops after delivering the audit report without modifying or creating any files in the repository (git status is clean).

assertions.name: measured-multilang-counts
assertions.text: Reports script/cloc-measured commentLines, allowedLines (> 0 from existing WHY: markers), and countedLines across both TypeScript and Python with vendor/ excluded.

assertions.name: catches-both-stale-and-traps
assertions.text: Classifies both contradictory stale comments (moment.js in packages/web/src/format.ts and 10-attempt backoff in services/worker/sync.py) as Stale, while keeping JSDoc @schemaFormat, section header, and catch comment out of the deletion list.

assertions.name: proposes-cross-file-adr-and-estimate
assertions.text: Proposes an ADR for the cross-file monotonic clientSeq invariant, gives a realistic sample-based delete estimate (7-13 lines, not raw countedLines=23) with sample size, names the existing gate (package.json or .github/workflows/ci.yml), and notes Not covered items (vendor/, trailing comments).

evals.name: mixed-monorepo-whole-repo-ratchet-en
evals.prompt: Clean up all noisy, stale, and excuse comments across this whole repo and wire a comment ratchet into CI so comments cannot grow back. Don't post issues to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Whole-repo TS+Python cleanup and CI ratchet: deletes all tautologies, both stale comments, and records both excuses in docs/comment-debt.md; preserves JSDoc @schemaFormat, section header, catch comment, directives, and vendor/thirdparty.py; moves cross-file clientSeq decision into docs/adr/0002-*.md; copies comment_ratchet.py and creates whole-repo baseline excluding vendor/ and the ratchet script itself so check STILL PASSES after git add -A; wires check into package.json and .github/workflows/ci.yml (with cloc installed in CI); proves fail-then-pass and passes npm test.

assertions.name: removes-multilang-noise-and-stale
assertions.text: Deletes all 6 tautologies and both contradictory stale comments (moment.js and 10-attempt backoff) across TypeScript and Python, leaving vendor/thirdparty.py untouched.

assertions.name: preserves-traps-directives-and-tests
assertions.text: Preserves JSDoc @schemaFormat, section header, catch comment, existing WHY: markers, and directives (prettier-ignore, pragma: no cover); npm test (both Node and Python unittest) passes.

assertions.name: cross-file-adr-and-local-debt
assertions.text: Moves the cross-file monotonic clientSeq decision into docs/adr/0002-*.md (leaving ADR-0002 pointers in both TS and Python) and records both excuses in docs/comment-debt.md without posting externally.

assertions.name: ratchet-survives-git-add
assertions.text: Ratchet check passes (exit 0) both before AND after staging all newly created files with git add -A, without bloating the baseline with the ratchet script's own comments or staging files into git index.

assertions.name: ci-wired-with-cloc-and-proven
assertions.text: Wires check into existing package.json and/or .github/workflows/ci.yml (ensuring cloc is installed in the CI job), adds no new hook framework, reports before/after counts, and proves check fails on a throwaway comment and passes after revert.
